comments.author: Dr3vik
comments.body_html:
This usually happens when you have two copies of the mod installed. Please check:

1.Go to BepInEx/plugins/ folder 2.Search for BossNotifier - make sure there’s only ONE .dll file 3.Check subfolders too (like BepInEx/plugins/BossNotifier/) 4.Delete any duplicate files 5.Also delete BepInEx/config/Mattexe.BossNotifier.cfg to reset config 6.Restart the game

If you upgraded from a previous version, you might have both the old and new .DLL. file
